title: operation
description: An n-ary endofunction on a carrier, ω : A^n → A — internal (maps a carrier within itself), as opposed to a function/operator that maps between structures. The GENERAL operation; binary-operation is the arity-2 case and a 0-ary operation is a constant (a unit). The 'binary-operation' magma is built from is this object restricted to arity 2.

carrier.description: the carrier A the operation acts within

arity.description: n ≥ 0; n=0 constant/unit, n=1 unary (closure/endomorphism), n=2 binary-operation
